name: National Aeronautics and Space Act — Sec. 20132. Security requirements
notes: Authorizes NASA to establish security requirements for the protection of information and property.

derives_from.note: Science Clause (cl. 8 — "Progress of Science and useful Arts") is the foundational basis for federal civil-space activities; Necessary & Proper Clause (cl. 18) supports structuring NASA's information-protection responsibilities.
